mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_ticket (ticket_no, user_id, category, title, content, contact, status, is_read) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{contact}, #{status}, #{isRead})
mapper.sql: t.*, u.real_name AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, h.real_name AS handler_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM service_ticket t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON h.id = t.handler_id WHERE t.id = #{id}

where.if: AND (t.ticket_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR t.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.real_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM service_ticket t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON h.id = t.handler_id
ORDER BY t.is_read ASC, CASE t.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM service_ticket t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE service_ticket SET is_read = 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_read = 0
UPDATE service_ticket SET status = 'PROCESSING', handler_id = #{handlerId}, is_read = 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE service_ticket SET status = 'DONE', handler_id = COALESCE(handler_id, #{handlerId}), handled_at = now(), is_read = 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
UPDATE service_ticket SET status = 'DONE', handled_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM service_ticket WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT count(*) FROM service_ticket WHERE is_read = 0 AND status != 'DONE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_reply (ticket_id, author_id, author_role, content) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{authorId}, #{authorRole}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.real_name AS author_name FROM ticket_reply r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.author_id WHERE r.ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC
